All sparrows are parrots and no parrot is penguin -> no penguin is a sparrow (II follows)
check_code:
from itertools import product
# regions: each element type = membership tuple (E,S,Pa,Pe); a model = set of nonempty types
types=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
I_always=II_always=True
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    m=[t for i,t in enumerate(types) if mask>>i&1]
    if not any(t[0] and t[1] for t in m): continue
    if any(t[1] and not t[2] for t in m): continue
    if any(t[2] and t[3] for t in m): continue
    if not any(t[2] and t[0] for t in m): I_always=False
    if any(t[3] and t[1] for t in m): II_always=False
ans={(1,0):"A",(0,1):"B",(1,1):"C",(0,0):"D"}[(int(I_always),int(II_always))]
assert ans=="C" and ans not in "ABD"
